compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a menu for a grocery shopping application. The main contents and functions include a categorized list of grocery items and services. The categories listed are:

1. Wines, Beers & Spirits
2. Laundry and Home Care
3. Baking & Cooking
4. Breakfast
5. Candy & Chocolate
6. Canned, Dry & Packaged Foods
7. Snacks
8. Gourmet Food and Gifts
9. Beverages
10. Tobacco
11. Ice Cream
12. Mobile Campaign
13. Vouchers and Services

Each category has a "+" icon next to it, indicating that it can be expanded to view more items or subcategories within that section. The top of the screen shows a navigation bar with a back arrow, a shopping cart icon with a notification badge, and a menu icon. The time is displayed at the top right corner.
